notes.title: VRLegs Shooter Mode Update (0.6.20241220)
notes.content:
🎮 VRLegs Shooter Mode Update (0.6.20241220)
Hey Runners!

It’s time to lock and load – we’re introducing our first combat game mode!
🎯 NEW GAME MODE: FFA SHOOTER⚔️ Free-For-All combat in Blockpark🔫 Weapon Pickup System: Scavenge and fight!🚫 No items allowed – pure shooting action💪 Test your aim and movement skills in this adrenaline-packed mode!✨ OTHER NEW FEATURES🤸 Side Flip: Enter a T-pose when your movement direction differs from your facing direction by at least 35°.💥 Hard Landing: Crouch to avoid fall damage!👥 VoteKick Console: Kick, mute, or report players directly in-game.🎭 New Community Avatars: Special thanks to @LIL_CHUNKER and @YummyMealGold for their contributions!🔧 GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS
⚡ DeadZone: Now resets your position and depletes energy to 0.

🏃 No more sliding cooldown – smooth movement all the way!

🧎 Real-Life Crouch Sliding: Slide low and fast!

👣 Silent Crouch Walking: Sneak up on your enemies.

🎈 Two-Handed BalloonGun Control: Added precision for balloon-based combat.

💣 Bombs: Now explode instantly on ground contact.

🎯 CrossBow: Improved handling for better accuracy.

🚩 CheckpointFlags: Rebalanced: 
Energy Cost: 3 → 1Now resets position and depletes energy to 0.
🔄 TeleportBall renamed to Telepots
🐞 FIXES🫧 Fixed SceneBubble issues.🎈 Fixed BalloonGun-Firework crash.🔇 Fixed BlockPark music controls.🔥 Grab your weapons and join the action!
We can’t wait to see you dominate the new FFA Shooter mode. Have fun, and as always, happy running!

~ VRLegs Team

notes.title: New Map Devlog - Walled City
notes.content:
New Map - Walled City 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/b3c2bf12ecab908bf96a465d2a770087d5db788f.png

Hello there Runners! In today’s Devlog we would like to talk a little bit more about the new map called Walled City. You were often asking about the new map and now we would like to share more details about it! We are planning to release a new map by the end of June.

Here is a couple of words from where we took inspiration:

World Backgroun
Once, Kowloon Walled City was a labyrinthine community teeming with dense buildings, narrow alleys, and vibrant life. Its inhabitants created a self-sufficient micro-society bustling with energy and stories aplenty. However, as the impacts of global warming intensified, rising sea levels caused catastrophic floods that engulfed much of the world. Cities and civilizations were submerged, but some structures survived, including that resilient urban symbol—the Kowloon Walled City.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/ab1420672acf34a1a278be876e3820299a3b21b0.png
Beneath the Tide
The face of the world was completely altered. The water's surface, like glass, reflected the lifeless skies above, and towering relics became the islands of the new world. Kowloon Walled City, with its sturdy construction and unique geographical position, became a haven for survivors. As time passed, it came to resemble more a solitary island, standing tall amidst the expansive watery realm.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/c99b07989b526bc5f16cd713c792b57db5b19cc2.png
Life Anew on the Rooftops
In this new era, the rooftops of the city and the bridges connecting them became the new territories for survival. Residents reinvented their way of living to adapt to life in this elevated world. They established gardens on rooftops, collected rainwater, and even engineered rudimentary wind and solar devices to generate electricity. Between rooftops, people built temporary bridges out of ropes, planks, and recycled materials, forming an intricate network for parkour.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/9bb5fef02af43082329ffbc371893d5ecd983867.png
Parkour—A Means of Survival
In this reshaped world by the flood, parkour became more than a sport—it was an essential skill for survival. People used parkour to transport goods, exchange information, and even trade between buildings. Young daredevils showcased their abilities and bravery by leaping and climbing through these architectural remnants. They became the explorers and heroes of legend in the new age.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/7cf7e508f3da9064c0f7abad729bb8d56cf60922.png
Beacon of Civilization
Even as the outside world lay submerged and forsaken, Kowloon Walled City stood as a beacon of hope—a resilient community persisting in a post-apocalyptic world. Over time, it became not just a hub for material resources but a lighthouse for cultural and knowledge preservation. The people living there, despite various challenges, created a new way of life, providing hope and inspiration for future generations.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/a45142decf27115cffa58c0758a41e121d97b85d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/02e80691ee0fc5f3b6d13fef4531bfa063bf6734.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/924bd42e212f5219e420ed84e811c594cd349ce3.png

References
Click HERE for a reference video to give you a more historical look at the new map!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/c402a59af3797eb609ebab9ef976aa001a3f846a.png

Probably one of the most important aspects of the new map is that it will be completely FREE TO PLAY!

We hope that you have enjoyed this Devlog. See you in the next one!

Have a great day!

~VR Legs Team

notes.title: New update - 0.3.1.240515.b
notes.content:
Hello Runners!

Today we are coming to you with a New Update 0.3.1.240515.b! Hope you will enjoy the new changes! 

Lets jump into it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/501aa63289fcbd17d146614096df77f44f6d2c4e.png

New Features:

1. Item and Energy System:


 Players can now generate and use items, or provide them for others. Creating items will consume energy, which players can collect from energy fragments that appear randomly in the game during parkour activities.


2. New Items Added:


 Bomb: Throw it to create an explosion after a delay, launching nearby objects into the air.
 Checkpoint Flag: Place it anywhere; if you hit a Dead Zone, you'll respawn at the flag's location.
 Firework: Launch a firework from your hand to pull yourself a short distance.
 Paraglider: Glide long distances from high places, controlling your flight speed and direction with your hands.
 Peek Lens: A transparent lens to see other players and keys through objects.
 Sonic Horn: Emits sound waves that push away nearby objects.
 Teleport Ball: Throw it and teleport to where it lands, if it’s not intercepted.
 Teleport Talkies: Comes in pairs. Share with another player for long-distance communication and teleportation to each other's location.


3. Shop System:


 A new shop system is now available for purchasing items.


4. Tasks for Tokens:


 Complete tasks to earn tokens used in the shop.


5. Notification System:


 Stay updated with in-game notifications about important events and updates.


Content Optimizations:



 Disabled lip sync for speaking to improve performance.
 Enabled real-time shadows and enhanced rendering resolution on Quest 3.
 Improved the throwing experience.
 Adjusted gameplay boundaries: Players moving outside a specified area will immediately become the Tagger.
 New players joining mid-game will start as the Tagger.
 Added imperial units for displaying height.
 Introduced a Weekly Leaderboard.
 Implemented a user reporting system to manage community rule violations.
 Display boards for community rules are now available within the game scenes.
 Players can now adjust the game's maximum movement speed.
 Added an option for auto-forward running and to disable the right joystick jump.
 Moderators can now access an in-game moderator interface.



Bug Fixes

 Resolved an issue where a light press on the grab key caused incorrect gestures.
 Fixed a bug in the PC version's culling related to camera activation disrupting the main view.
 Addressed the issue where wall jumps were too low when falling at high speeds.


Thank you for the time and support you are giving us!

Have a great day!

~VR Legs Team

notes.title: Items Devlog
notes.content:
Items

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/9a5d833c8a0846e2a0b77ad7f067cd17c521ad7d.png

Hello there Runners! In today’s Devlog we would like to talk a little bit more about the Items that you will be able to buy in the in-game store. We hope that items will give you a lot of fun and will greatly improve the interaction between players.

We've added these items to increase the interactivity among players and the strategic depth within the game. The previous version of the Tag Game was more about skill execution, but it lacked strong interaction and strategic elements between players.

Here is the list of new Items that will be available:

Glider

 A hang glider that lets you jump from high places and glide long distances. You can control the speed and direction of your flight with your hands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/48e233773f616c3bd17c944fa00612acefd78696.gif
Loudspeaker

 When used, it emits sound waves that can push away all objects around you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/8b6ba9ffd1531c3be997faaab22c1e84363fac48.gif
Teleport Phone

 Similar to a walkie-talkie, it comes in pairs. You can give one to another player, allowing you to communicate over long distances, and also to teleport to their location.



CheckPoint Flag

 You can place it anywhere, and if you enter a Dead Zone, you will be reset to the location where you placed the flag.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/3b7df4638dee1d881fc09b7cce3616e54fa14390.gif



Teleport Ball

 You can throw this ball, and the interesting part is that your camera will follow the ball, similar to Sniper Elite. However, you won't be able to move your character. If another player captures you, you will be pulled back. If not captured, you will teleport to the ball's landing spot when it hits the ground.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/d1c30491df46e2472779beb21af6e76ae6ec5889.gif

Firework

 You can launch a firework from your hand, which pulls you along for a short distance.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/ae1d02dd52c81ce43107e33db0aef393230d5d0b.gif



Bomb
 You can throw it, and after a certain period, it will explode, sending all nearby objects flying into the air.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/a846d5e4de57697c8f31e50855a65a39865ffa22.gif

Using In-Game Items requires you to consume your energy, similar to how some games require the use of mana to cast spells. If you don't have enough mana, you can't perform the spell. Our Game Items are designed in the same way. To replenish your energy, you need to collect energy fragments scattered throughout the scene.

We are planning to build up the in-game shop, so you can expect more items added to the game in the future!
Thank you for your time, we hope that you like the next steps in the development of our game!

See you in the next Devlog!

notes.title: In-Game Store Devlog
notes.content:
IN-GAME STORE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/f462f59f6b1a2803e17e16c7572c20a5e0cb8a95.png

Hello there Runners! In today’s Devlog we would like to talk about the In-Game Store that we will be adding to the game. We hope that items that you will be able to buy in the store will greatly increase fun and interactions between players.
We are planning to add a vending machine in the corner of the map where players will be able to buy items. 

As for now, we are planning to release the following items:


 Gliders: These allow players to glide through the air.
 Teleportation Phones: These are devices for two players. The players holding these devices can talk to each other from a distance, and one can teleport to the other's location.
 Teleportation Flags: These can be placed anywhere on the map. If multiple teleportation flags exist on a map, a player holding a flag can initiate teleportation and will be transported to a random other flag location.
 Fireworks: After being used, they can carry a player through the air like a small rocket and will explode after a certain distance.
 Loudspeaker: When a player speaks into the loudspeaker, it creates a sound wave that can push players and items away.
 Bombs: After exploding, the bomb will push any players within the blast radius outward.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/8b6ba9ffd1531c3be997faaab22c1e84363fac48.gif

Items are unlocked permanently. However, some items may be restricted from use on certain maps, depending on the game mode for that map. All of those items can be shared with other players in the lobby!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937012/48e233773f616c3bd17c944fa00612acefd78696.gif

To unlock the items from the shop, you will need to get in-game Tokens.

Here is how you can obtain them:


 Tokens can be obtained through in-game purchases, adding real money.
 Tokens can be earned by completing in-game tasks


We are planning to build up the in-game shop, so you can expect more items added to the game in the future!
Thank you for your time, we hope that you like the next steps in the development of our game!

See you in the next Devlog!
